title: Mortavie Font
author: Colourful
description:
Introducing MORTAVIE, a bold and sophisticated display serif typeface designed for eye-catching luxury and editorial designs.
MORTAVIE features dramatic high-contrast letterforms, distinctive serif details, elegant curves, and a strong fashion-forward personality. Its unique character makes it perfect for designs that need a premium, memorable, and stylish typographic presence.
Perfect for luxury branding, fashion editorials, beauty packaging, wedding stationery, boutique logos, perfume labels, magazine headlines, posters, invitations, social media graphics, and premium packaging.
Perfect For:
Luxury & Fashion Branding
Editorial & Magazine Design
Beauty & Cosmetic Branding
Perfume & Product Packaging
Wedding Invitations
Boutique Branding
Logo & Identity Design
Posters & Headlines
Social Media Graphics
Premium Packaging
Stationery & Invitations
Font Details:

Give your projects a distinctive luxury-editorial appearance with the bold and refined style of MORTAVIE.
